task:
CONTINUATION run. The wip/run-persistence checkpoint (HEAD) implements incremental pipeline-run persistence but has SIX concrete defects. Fix all six; the sensor set is the definition of done.

Context: PipelineService.Run persists a run record at creation (status=pending) and only again after Execute returns, so in-flight runs look 'pending' for hours. The checkpoint adds a persist hook (executor.persistRun) called after run.Start() and after each execution batch, plus store methods UpdateActive/FailInterrupted.

The five defects, all verified against HEAD:
1. NIL-EXECUTOR PANIC: NewPipelineService (internal/app/pipeline_service.go:42) calls s.executor.SetRunPersister(...) unconditionally; tests construct NewPipelineService(repos, repos, nil) and panic (TestSubscribeBus_NilBus). FIX THE DESIGN, not the symptom: delete the SetRunPersister setter entirely and pass the persist callback as a parameter to Execute (e.g. Execute(ctx, p, run, persist func(context.Context, *pipeline.Run) error)). Execute's only production caller is pipeline_service.go:131; NewPipelineExecutor's signature stays as-is; update test callers of Execute to pass the new argument (nil or a spy) WITHOUT changing what they assert.
2. DUPLICATED PERSIST BLOCK: internal/app/pipeline_executor.go has the same 'persist after start' block TWICE (before and after publishEvent). Keep exactly one.
3. INTERFACE POLLUTION: internal/domain/pipeline/repository.go declares UpdateActive(ctx, run *Run) and FailInterrupted on BOTH PipelineRepository and RunRepository. PipelineRepository deals in *Pipeline - run methods do not belong on it. The only FailInterrupted caller (cmd/composerd/main.go:304) already calls it on the RunRepository. Remove both methods from PipelineRepository; keep them on RunRepository; adjust the concrete store (internal/infra/store/pipeline_repo.go) so both interfaces are still satisfied.
4. TIMING-DEPENDENT ACCEPTANCE TEST: TestPipelineExecutor_IncrementalPersist (internal/app/pipeline_executor_test.go) fails because its steps complete in ~1ms - by the time it reads the store the run is already 'success'. Make the observation window REAL: give the pipeline a step slow enough to observe mid-run state (a shell_command step that sleeps briefly, or a second batch gated behind it), and keep the existing assertions (running-with-0-steps, then running-with-1-step, then success-with-2). Do NOT delete or weaken assertions to make it pass.
5. MISSING TRAILING NEWLINE: internal/app/pipeline_service.go ends without a newline. Restore it.
6. DUPLICATE TEST DECLARATION: internal/infra/store/pipeline_repo_test.go declares TestRunRepo_UpdateActive TWICE (second at :348) - `go vet ./...` fails to compile the store test package. Merge or rename so each test is declared once and the assertions of both are preserved (if they assert the same thing, keep the stronger one).

Preserve the semantics that are already correct: every persist guarded by ctx.Err() == nil (a cancelled run must never be flipped back to running); UpdateActive keeps its conditional-update behaviour; FailInterrupted stays wired at startup.
rules: NEVER run ./composerd or go run ./cmd/composerd/ - its startup hook encrypts ~/.ssh keys. Verify with go build / go test only.

GOCACHE AND GOMODCACHE: always run go commands as `GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOMODCACHE=/tmp/gomodcache go ...` (your HOME cache is read-only in the sandbox). NEVER let go write a repo-local .cache/ directory - thousands of cache files crash the loop's accounting.

The acceptance test must FINISH in well under 60 seconds: make the slow step a short shell sleep (200-500ms), poll the store with a hard deadline of a few seconds, and fail the test explicitly when the deadline lapses - no unbounded waits, no `select{}`, no retry-forever loops.
EDIT DISCIPLINE: no whole-file rewrites. Read the exact region first, then edit with exact oldText copied from that read. Run `go build ./...` after every edit and fix what breaks before moving on.
Do not modify or weaken any existing test ASSERTION. Updating Execute call sites in tests to pass the new persist argument is allowed; changing what they assert is not.
Do not run git commit / git reset / git checkout / git stash - the loop harness owns git state.
No new dependencies. No new exported symbols beyond what the Execute-parameter design requires.
If you need a paragraph-long comment to justify why a workaround is OK, the code is wrong - fix the code.

sensors.hint: Go compile error. Read the named file/line and fix it - if Execute's signature changed, every test caller needs the new argument.

sensors.name: vet
sensors.hint: go vet failure - usually a Printf-style mismatch or unused symbol introduced by the edit.
sensors.canary: printf '\nfunc canaryVetBadPrintf() { fmt.Printf("%%d\\n", "not an int") }\n' >> internal/app/pipeline_executor.go

sensors.name: unit
sensors.hint: Go unit tests (race detector on). A nil-pointer panic in NewPipelineService means defect 1 is not fixed. A DATA RACE means a persist runs while step goroutines are active.

sensors.name: feature-incremental-persist
sensors.hint: Defect 4: the test reads the store AFTER the 1ms steps already finished, so it sees 'success' instead of 'running'. Make a step slow (shell_command sleep) so mid-run state is genuinely observable, keep the assertions, and make sure the implementation persists after Start and after each batch.

sensors.name: contract-no-setter
sensors.hint: Defect 1: the SetRunPersister setter still exists. Pass the persist callback as an Execute parameter instead and delete the setter.

sensors.name: contract-iface-clean
sensors.cmd: awk '/type PipelineRepository interface/,/^}/' internal/domain/pipeline/repository.go | rg -q 'UpdateActive|FailInterrupted|Run' && exit 1 || exit 0
sensors.hint: Defect 3: PipelineRepository still declares run-oriented methods. UpdateActive and FailInterrupted belong on RunRepository only.

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --spec 'Continuation cleanup of an incremental pipeline-run persistence change. The diff must: (1) delete the SetRunPersister setter and pass the persist callback as an Execute parameter - no executor mutation after construction; (2) keep exactly ONE persist-after-Start block and one persist-after-each-batch block, every persist guarded by ctx.Err()==nil so a cancelled run is never resurrected; (3) remove UpdateActive/FailInterrupted from PipelineRepository while keeping them on RunRepository with the concrete store still satisfying both interfaces and cmd/composerd/main.go untouched; (4) make TestPipelineExecutor_IncrementalPersist genuinely observe mid-run state via a slow step - a test that would pass on the pre-change code, or with weakened assertions, is a FAIL; (5) preserve UpdateActive conditional-update semantics and FailInterrupted startup wiring. Reject: nil-guards that keep the setter, duplicated blocks, new exported abstractions, paragraph-long justification comments, weakened or deleted test assertions.' --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3
sensors.hint: The judge found a correctness or scope problem deterministic sensors are blind to. Read its finding literally and fix the code, not the message.
